description: What to do and learn on which day: every studiewijzer item (lesson, day and week items) for a date range, grouped by day, with description, learning goals, time estimate, test type, teacher note, attachments (file links), external links, hand-in window and status, and the done tick. Also lists hand-in deadlines per day. Defaults to today plus 6 days; at most 42 days. Every item lists bijlagen (fileUrl, readable with download_attachment) and externeMaterialen; empty means the teacher attached nothing (lesmateriaal=true is only a flag, there is no separate material call).

from.description: First date of the range. Defaults to today.

leerlingId.description: Numeric leerling id. Required when more than one child is linked.
